id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

previewRemoteDataError.description: The inline notification to display errors in `PreviewAndSelectDataStep` and `EditSelectedTableSchemaStep`

sqlConnectionsCache.description:
A map of {@link SqlSourceSystem#name} to cached information about the remote connection for quick lookup in the UI.
This intentionally lives outside the {@link sourceSystemsCache} because it may include cached information for
{@link SqlSourceSystem}s that may not get fully configured by a user. In these cases, the concepts should remain
distinct in Redux state.

remoteDataPreviewTypeMeta.description: The type metadata for the current selection when previewing a remote table.

editRemoteTypeMetaCache.description:
Map only for storing remote {@link DataFusionUiTypeMeta} for `EditSelectedTableSchemaStep`, mapping from {@link SourceCollection} name to edited DataFusionUiTypeMeta
the map only stores DataFusionUiTypeMeta in intermediate edit state.

remoteTypeMetaCache.description:
Map only for storing remote {@link TypeMeta} for `EditSelectedTableSchemaStep`, mapping from {@link SourceCollection} name to {@link TypeMeta}.
the map only stores the unedited / original TypeMeta.

sourceName.description:
Name of the schema that will be used to generate the {@link Source}.
{@link TypeMeta} for this schema will be stored in the {@link SelfServiceDIApplicationState#editTypeMetaCache}.

targetName.description:
Name of the schema that will be used to generate the {@link Persistable} types.
{@link TypeMeta} for the target will be stored in the {@link SelfServiceDIApplicationState#editTypeMetaCache}.

selectFilesAndCreateSchemaError.description: The error to display when issues occur in the select files and create schema step

selectedFilePreview.description: The selected preview to render in the target preview tab

fileUploadSourceCollection.description: The FileSourceCollection be to upserted in the file upload flow.

selectedBucketFileNames.description: The list of file names in the selected bucket

selectedPathForExternalFileSystem.description: The selected path in the state

selectFilePathError.description: The error message for selecting a file path

canonicalSelectionError.description: The error message for canonical selection in the integrate sources step

filesFromSelectedUrl.description: The list of files from the selected URL

selectedFileDetail.description: The details of the selected file

selectedPartitionForDataPreview.description: The details of the selected file

streamsAvailable.description: The details of the selected file

selectedShardRecord.description: The data of the selected shard

canonicalsAvailable.description: The canonicals available to be selected

integrateSourcesSidePanelOpenClose.description: Used to toggle the open/close state of the integrate sources side panel for canonicals list

mountQuery.description:
The search query for an input that utilizes {@link UiSdlSingleSearch#actionableOptionsConfig}.
Used for selecting the option to create a new mount in the External File flows

integrateSourcesGraphToTransformer.description: Used to toggle the integrate sources graph or transformer within the container

integrateSourcesTypeOfTransform.description: Stores the value of the type of transform (projection/transformer)

selectedNodeFromTheGraph.description: Used to toggle the integrate sources graph to selected transformer component or filter component within the container

cdcConfigCache.description:
CDC configuration stored per source collection to support independent configuration for each table.
Structure: cdcConfigCache[sourceCollectionName] = { enabled, trackingColumn, schedule }

transformFilterTypeMeta.description:
TypeMeta for the filter preview table.
Used to generate table columns when previewing filter results.
Contains field information (TypeMeta) needed to render the preview table columns.

displayFilterPreviewTable.description: Used to toggle the display of the filter preview table

filterConditionSourceFieldsCache.description:
Cache for storing source fields fetched from the server for filter condition validation.
Maps from source name to array of field types (same type as TypeMeta.declaredFieldTypes) to avoid repeated API calls.

automapRunning.description: Indicates whether the automap operation is currently running

title: Application state for storing information needed in the add / edit data source multistep component flow.
name: SelfServiceDIAddDataSourceApplicationState
